_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY. This configuration exists to make each control visible in
a figure; it is not evidence-derived and is not one of the four profiles
reported in the results. It is written by hand rather than produced by
build_profiles.py precisely because its parameters are chosen for legibility
rather than traceability, and mixing the two would blur that distinction.
- a base of three wanted groups, so a score exists to be raised or lowered
- one demonstration group that is well enough mapped for all four
treatments to produce a visible, different map
- a dining bundle with enough members that grouping versus separate
- thresholds wide enough that the effects read at whole-city scale

demo.label: Demonstration configuration
demo.basis: Illustrative. Not evidence-derived; used only for the component-effect figures.
